content:
Formula: Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion
Exact Expression: \left| \bigcup_{i=1}^n A_i \right| = \sum_{k=1}^n (-1)^{k-1} \sum_{1 \le i_1 < \dots < i_k \le n} |A_{i_1} \cap \dots \cap A_{i_k}|
Definitions: Counting technique computing the size of a union of finite sets by alternating additions and subtractions of intersections.
Derivation/Reference: Abraham de Moivre (1718); Daniel da Silva (1854); J. J. Sylvester (1883)
Example: For 2 sets: |A|=10, |B|=15, |A cap B|=4 -> |A cup B| = 10 + 15 - 4 = 21
Domain: discrete_mathematics
Assumptions: A_i are finite sets
Common Errors: Sign alternation errors at higher orders k
subject: Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion
